quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns drivers that traffic may come from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming up.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: A left arm bent at the elbow and pointing upward means you are turning right or changing lanes to the right.

questions.question: This sign warns about what type of:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at the exact speed shown.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the maximum speed allowed on the road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: This sign warns you about:

options.text: A curve coming up in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve coming up in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always let pedestrians cross in crosswalks first. Pay attention to pedestrians when you drive through intersections or turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may go if the road is clear.
Come to a complete stop before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see these signs, you are going the wrong way and could hit an oncoming car. Turn around safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They tell drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that people may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells drivers that a stop sign is coming and they should get ready to stop completely.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders can use hand signals instead of turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They tell drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a _____________ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped warning signs are only used to show no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells drivers to watch for traffic coming from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first if needed. You must stop at a yield sign if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must stay to either the right or the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is coming. Watch for traffic from other directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
You can only turn in certain directions from certain lanes.
Both lanes must merge smoothly together.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. HOV lanes are only for buses and cars with the driver plus at least one passenger, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the bridge or overpass ahead is low. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and honk your horn.
A bus stop is coming up.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. You should slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it rains or gets wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: You can pass slow vehicles if you do it quickly.
You can pass if you know the road well.
You can pass only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign (white with black markings). You must obey all regulation signs. This sign means passing other vehicles is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only go in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A person with a flag ahead.
You can turn left from either direction.

questions.explanation: This regulation sign controls how traffic moves. It means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A person with a flag is directing traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A person with a flag is directing traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign means the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Divided highway begins. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated on the sign (in this case, 35 mph).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to road hazards. This sign tells you the road may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: At a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride beside the road. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles may be crossing or riding nearby.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. It means you should stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means a lane is ending and traffic will merge. Be ready to let cars merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: A yellow and black diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Warns you about road or traffic conditions ahead.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about road or traffic conditions ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on yellow. They alert you to hazards and conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The highest safe speed in a residential area.
The highest safe speed for an expressway exit.
The highest safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The highest safe speed in a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the highest safe speed for a highway exit. In this example, it shows 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community group is picking up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the chevron points. In this case, the road curves to the left. You may see several chevron signs throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a curve is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Be careful because pedestrians may be crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is prohibited. You cannot make U-turns where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
Stop completely and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Drivers from entering full parking lots.
Drivers from entering road construction areas.
Drivers from entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers from entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic only flows one way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road will cross a divided highway.
You are driving on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road will cross a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road will cross a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or barrier between them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a traffic signal is coming. Get ready to stop for red lights or yield to cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let other vehicles merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead becomes a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When your left arm is extended straight out to the left, you are signaling a left turn or left lane change.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road has a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turns, and increase your distance from the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people walking across the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: From bottom to top, what is the order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: From bottom to top, traffic lights are arranged in this order: green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order for traffic lights?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic lights, red is always at the top and green is always at the bottom. On horizontal lights, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns you that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully and be ready to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the right lane will end soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right, then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are important for communication when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that when turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a road will cross ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A bicycle repair shop is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead shows red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead shows green.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right or go straight.
You may turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down and let trains pass. Trains cannot stop for cars.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for road hazards ahead. This yellow sign with black markings warns of low clearance.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves right and then left ahead. Slow down so you can safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make U-turns where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it signals that the rider will slow down or stop. You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads divided by a median. You must stay on the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection ahead where a road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that tells drivers what they must do. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then go if it is safe.
Go through the intersection slowly, but you may not need to stop.
Stop only if traffic is on the other road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then go if it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. Then proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: In group riding, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in a group. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, all riders should stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers which direction to drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: Can either continue or exit from your current lane.
Can stay in your lane and continue through.
Must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will exit the freeway and will not continue through the interchange. You can change lanes to continue, or you must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is coming from both directions ahead.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and points with one finger?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points with one finger, it tells other riders to form a single line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow backgrounds. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you what you must or must not do. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to show their intentions. When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, they are signaling that they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards. This sign warns you that an upcoming bridge is narrow. You may not be able to safely meet or pass a truck on it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a traffic light is ahead. Be ready to respond to red or yellow lights.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to road hazards. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider extends their left arm out with palm facing up and swings it upward, it tells other riders to increase speed.

questions.question: What is the main danger shown by this sign?

options.text: Headlights may be misaligned if one side of your vehicle is higher than the other.
A tire can be damaged if you drift onto the shoulder.
Your vehicle may hydroplane if water is on the shoulder.
You may lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must do. Wherever you see this sign, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign warn about?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.
Trucks are on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has limited height.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has limited height.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has limited height. Do not drive through if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (in this case, 13 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign means a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. Drivers must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane on a multilane road ends ahead. Traffic in the right lane must move left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging in from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging in from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that traffic from the right side is about to merge onto the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. You should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves to the right, then to the left.
The road ahead curves to the left, then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves to the right, then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you the road curves right first, then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Yield the right-of-way and proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes are about to become one. Traffic from both lanes will combine into a single lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means parking is not allowed here.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Give the right-of-way to pedestrians and oncoming cars. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction and maintenance work. This sign tells you to slow down and drive carefully through the work zone ahead.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Speed up to avoid traffic jams.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, make room for entering vehicles. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let them in.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is coming up. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic on a green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on a green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light to tell drivers that left-turning traffic must wait for oncoming cars to pass first, even if the light is green.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs mean "yield." Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first if needed. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you it is not safe to enter this road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and find another way.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road when conditions are good. You may need to drive slower when the weather or road conditions are poor.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means "stop." You must come to a full stop and wait for other vehicles and pedestrians to pass before you go.
